comments: cb555372: This block initializes the deletion process for patient incomplete records.
819d8363: Entry point for the deletion routine.
53d4647a: Checks if division selection is enabled, then prompts for division if so.
feaf2e0e: Sets the default division if no division is specifically selected.
6efbb0b5: Alerts user that division parameters for delinquency tracking are not set up if missing.
b67bf5f2: Ensures only records from the selected division are listed for deletion.
c6eb13dd: Prompts the user to select a patient incomplete record to delete.
0225caea: Prepares to display the selected record for confirmation before deletion.
2901b93c: Initializes variables for the OKD process.
d6e048bd: Resets the VALMBCK variable, which controls the return location after an action.
1476a057: Calls the selection utility to let the user choose which record to act on.
db654961: Sets up the screen for a full view before returning to the list view.
5191592e: Loops through all selected entries for deletion and calls the edit routine for each.
8f2d8633: Finalizes the process and returns to the report.
5fd4514d: Prompts for confirmation before deleting the selected entry.
5cf47e51: If confirmed, deletes the record and displays a deletion message.
fe861dac: Exits the deletion confirmation loop if the user chooses not to delete.
1aca1fcc: Sets a flag to indicate the user has exited the process.
2fd1b1c9: Cleans up variables and quits the routine.
6f4260ce: Provides instructions for the 'Ok to delete' prompt.
